print("before dots:", dots(current_frame))

changed = [(i,j,a[i][j],b[i][j]) for i in range(len(a)) for j in range(len(a[0])) if a[i][j]!=b[i][j]]
from collections import Counter
print("changed:", len(changed), Counter((c[2],c[3]) for c in changed))
